name: Human emissions
description: Data describing the human sources of pathogen emissions and the factors that determine how human excreta reaches soil and surface water.

subcategories.name: Population
subcategories.description: Population, urbanization, age distribution, and Human Development Index data that determine the scale and spatial distribution of human emissions.

subcategories.name: Sanitation
subcategories.description: Data describing toilet facilities and service levels that determine how much human excreta is contained, treated, or released to soil and water.

subcategories.name: Wastewater treatment
subcategories.description: Data describing treated sewage and fecal sludge fractions, treatment plant capacities, and treatment levels that determine pathogen removal before discharge.

name: Livestock emissions
description: Data describing livestock sources of pathogen emissions and the factors that determine how contaminated manure reaches land and surface water.

subcategories.name: Livestock population
subcategories.description: Animal numbers by species and area, together with biological parameters that determine manure-generated pathogen loads.

subcategories.name: Manure management
subcategories.description: Data describing manure storage, spreading, grazing, digestion, burning, and other systems that affect pathogen survival and transport pathways.

subcategories.name: Production systems
subcategories.description: Data describing the share of each animal group raised in intensive and extensive systems, which affects where manure is concentrated and enters the environment.

name: Concentrations
description: Data used to model the transport, survival, and resulting concentrations of pathogens in surface water.

subcategories.name: Hydrology
subcategories.description: River discharge, surface runoff, river temperature, and solar radiation data that control pathogen dilution, transport, and die-off in surface water.

name: Risk
description: Data used to translate pathogen concentrations and human exposure into probabilities of infection.

subcategories.name: Exposure pathways
subcategories.description: Contact routes and assumptions about exposure frequency, ingested volume, drinking-water treatment, and boiling that drive quantitative microbial risk assessment.
